### 1. Load packages

library(tidyverse) library(rstatix) library(ggplot2) library(gtools)
library(gplots) library(gdata) library(DBI) library(RMySQL)
library(readr)

### 2. Connect to database

con \<- dbConnect( MySQL(), user = "root", password = "tetrode", dbname
= "twobottleschoice", host = "192.168.25.156" )

dbListTables(con)

### 3. Extract database consumption data

tab_conso \<- dbGetQuery( con, " SELECT id_experience, numero_session,
start_session, end_session, numero_box, solution_drink1,
solution_drink2, concentration_drink1, concentration_drink2,
poids_animal, nom_animal, time, drink1, drink2, conso_end.drink1_end,
conso_end.drink2_end FROM session, box, animal, conso, ( SELECT drink1
AS drink1_end, drink2 AS drink2_end, box.id_box FROM conso, session, box
WHERE box.id_session = session.id_session AND conso.id_box = box.id_box
AND end_session = time ) conso_end WHERE session.id_session =
box.id_session AND box.id_animal = animal.id_animal AND conso.id_box =
box.id_box AND conso_end.id_box = box.id_box AND hour(time) = '8' AND
minute(time) = '53' ORDER BY box.id_animal, numero_session, time " )

write.csv(tab_conso, "BDD_2BC.csv", row.names = FALSE)

### 4. Select experiment of interest

ExpQui \<- tab_conso %\>% filter(id_experience == 54)

### 5. Define mice included in the experiment

mice \<- paste0("CM", 35:50)

### 6. Function: compute consumption for one mouse

make_mouse_consumption \<- function(mouse, data, active_solution,
control_solution) {

active_consumption \<- Consofunction(active_solution, mouse, data)
control_consumption \<- Consofunction(control_solution, mouse, data)

bind_rows(control_consumption, active_consumption) %\>% mutate( mouse =
mouse, active_solution = active_solution, control_solution =
control_solution ) }

### 7. Nicotine vs water consumption

nicotine_consumption \<- mice %\>% set_names() %\>% map_dfr( \~
make_mouse_consumption( mouse = .x, data = ExpQui, active_solution =
"Nicotine", control_solution = "eauB" ), .id = "mouse_id" )

### 8. Quinine vs water consumption

quinine_consumption \<- mice %\>% set_names() %\>% map_dfr( \~
make_mouse_consumption( mouse = .x, data = ExpQui, active_solution =
"Quinine", control_solution = "eauB" ), .id = "mouse_id" )

### 9. Second water baseline period

water2_consumption \<- mice %\>% set_names() %\>% map_dfr( \~
Consofunction("eauB2", .x, ExpQui) %\>% mutate(mouse = .x), .id =
"mouse_id" )

### 10. Convert consumption to preference data

nicotine_preferences \<- nicotine_consumption %\>% group_split(mouse)
%\>% map_dfr(VolReelfunction, .id = "mouse_index")

quinine_preferences \<- quinine_consumption %\>% group_split(mouse) %\>%
map_dfr(VolReelfunction, .id = "mouse_index")

### 11. Manual correction for session 11

# This section is intentionally not automated.

# It reconstructs a corrupted session caused by bottle leakage.

DataSession11 \<- read_csv(
"ownCloud/LabMaria/Data/2bc/ExpQui/finalfiles/20221130_eauA2_eauB2_1.csv",
skip = 20 )

Data11afterfix \<- read_csv(
"ownCloud/LabMaria/Data/2bc/ExpQui/finalfiles/2022121_eauA2_eauB2afterfix11a_2.csv",
skip = 20 )

Data11forpoids \<- read_csv(
"ownCloud/LabMaria/Data/2bc/ExpQui/finalfiles/20221130_eauA2_eauB2_1.csv",
skip = 2 )

Data11afterfix \<- Data11afterfix %\>% mutate( Time =
as.character(Time), Date = as.character(Date) ) %\>% select(-7) %\>%
filter( Drink2 != "NA", Date != "NA" ) %\>% mutate(Drink2 =
as.numeric(Drink2))

# Keep your existing CM35--CM50 correction code below

### 12. Function: summarise preferences

summarise_preferences \<- function(data) { data %\>% group_by(Conc) %\>%
summarise( n = n(), mean_preference = mean(Preference, na.rm = TRUE),
sem_preference = sd(Preference, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n), mean_volume =
mean(volume, na.rm = TRUE), sem_volume = sd(volume, na.rm = TRUE) /
sqrt(n), mean_conc_reel = mean(ConcReel, na.rm = TRUE), sem_conc_reel =
sd(ConcReel, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n), .groups = "drop" ) }

### 13. Compute summaries

nicotine_summary \<- summarise_preferences(nicotine_preferences)
quinine_summary \<- summarise_preferences(quinine_preferences)

### 14. Plot results

plot_preference \<- function(summary_data, title_text) {
ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = as.factor(Conc), y = mean_preference)) +
geom_col() + geom_errorbar( aes( ymin = mean_preference -
sem_preference, ymax = mean_preference + sem_preference ), width = 0.2
) + labs( title = title_text, x = "Concentration", y = "Mean preference
(%)" ) + theme_minimal() }

plot_preference(nicotine_summary, "Nicotine preference by
concentration") plot_preference(quinine_summary, "Quinine preference by
concentration")

### 15. Save outputs

write.csv(nicotine_consumption, "nicotine_consumption.csv", row.names =
FALSE) write.csv(quinine_consumption, "quinine_consumption.csv",
row.names = FALSE)
